evidence: Walked all 27 scored/gate criteria (render 1, constraints 1, functional 16, polish 5, visual 4) against the frozen reference. (1) Runtime: qc/repairs/kittle-2026-10-08/results/golden-run.log (sha256 b2fb05f4..., matches index) records gate_constraints, all 16 functional criteria in judge order on one database, persistence after a real kill/relaunch (restart-pids.json old_pid 28 -> new_pid 58) and polish_refusal_in_place as PASS, dialogs []. The app was installed by the frozen solve.sh and run as uid 65534 with env -i and cwd /tmp; the frozen solution hashes (server.js 03b52651..., app.js 8fc558c9..., etc.) equal the run's matching_source_files. I compared tests/functional.cjs step by step with the CURRENT judge.toml text (sha 9de3577c..., same as the r3 commit ea885a3a made 2 minutes after the run) and it follows the same JUDGE literals, actors, replays and readbacks, e.g. stale edit 409 with typed text kept (functional.cjs:345-350), exactly-7-day boundary K-10 gone and K-11 kept (252-255), timer shortening deletes K-13 and its version, and the version replay returns 404 (269-280), hold scope/release/refusals (291-326), idempotent replay and C,A,B order across thread/search/transcript (431-455), live update preserving draft/reply target/scroll (457-477). (2) Source checks for legs the script checked loosely or not at all: signed-out replays get 401 {error:'Please sign in.'} and the transcript 401 page 'Not available. Please sign in.' (server.js:184,493); cross-client and walled reads answer a plain 404 'Not available.' (server.js:21,335,496); sign-out clears list/thread/mentions/results and hides #app (app.js:72-83); every non-deleted transcript row carries author, time, edited, On hold, 'In reply to' and depth indent, with versions for held edited messages (server.js:497-508); stale-edit base version is captured at startEdit and polling never touches the composer (app.js:377-387, 558-569), so the leg does not depend on judge speed. (3) Unscripted polish rows: timer label 'Messages disappear after N days' directly under the title (index.html:49-50, server.js:246); hold badge rendered inline without hover (app.js:309, styles.css:83); transcript replies are indented and labelled (transcript.css:132,137); phone at <=720px: single column, wrapping topbar, overflow-wrap:anywhere on messages, textarea width 100%, link box max-width calc(100vw-32px) (styles.css:72,110,114-123), so scrollWidth==390 is plausible. Visual likert anchors (sidebar current state + badges, calm hold badge/timer notice, 760px document transcript, phone wrapping) are plausibly 4-5 from styles.css/transcript.css. Render gate: real sign-in, nothing pre-sign-in, wrong password refused (verified in the scripted run). Seed facts used by criteria hold: K-8 'Draft will sent' (10 May) survives the 7-day shortening needed later; K-7 executor is held; K-17 'Insurer letter' (3 May, held) is overdue on release; 'Fenwick'/'heads of terms' exist only in M-12. No criterion found that the reference cannot pass. Counter-tests: a conforming alternative whose copy-link writes only to the clipboard is covered by app_context.md; a broken app that only hides controls is not credited because every refusal is a replay. RISK remains true because the evidence is a scripted Playwright run, not a configured claude-code/GLM judge run: no Oracle score, no render-gate/other-polish/visual runtime observation, no phone-width measurement, and no measurement that each individual-mode functional criterion (for example deleted_and_expired_messages, hold_scope_and_release) finishes inside the 550 s per-criterion timeout (functional/judge.toml:9-12 says 'Not yet measured against a judge run'). Minor provenance: run_golden.sh used images cw-editor-agent-r3 / cw-editor-verifier:current rather than images built from this task's Dockerfiles (agent Dockerfile hash equals the template's).
